["1", 10.7121] - ["2", 10.7665] … 共 12 行 yAxis: {type: value, min: 10, max: 11}","fontFamily":"Consolas","fontSize":12.5,"lineHeight":1.5,"color":"#DCE6E1","align":["left","top"]}},{"elementId":"code-caption","elementType":"text","bounds":[470,362,434,18],"content":{"text":"节选自本项目 pages/BRHY.page，已缩短并重排。","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":11,"lineHeight":1.4,"color":"#7A8480","align":["left","top"]}},{"elementId":"point","elementType":"text","bounds":[56,418,848,60],"content":{"text":"agent 可以只定位这一个对象，检查它的数值和边界，写入器能准确显示改了什么。版式和构图我仍然看渲染图：截图是审阅，不是整个文档。","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":15,"lineHeight":1.6,"color":"#3E4845","align":["left","top"]}},{"elementId":"ft-mark","elementType":"image","bounds":[56,505,16,16],"src":"media/.huandeng-versions/6b49274a35445235b8ab17f805b83cf3c7f8924630a5ce5ef8455e59aba5faef.png","sourceName":"huandeng.png","fit":{"mode":"contain"}},{"elementId":"ft-label","elementType":"text","bounds":[78,505,600,16],"content":{"text":"HUANDENG / 我为什么做幻灯","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":11,"lineHeight":1.3,"color":"#7A8480","align":["left","middle"]}},{"elementId":"ft-pos","elementType":"text","bounds":[824,505,80,16],"content":{"text":"0","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":11,"lineHeight":1.3,"color":"#7A8480","align":["right","middle"],"field":"main-position"}}] notes: "第三个问题，是我让 AI 改 Google Slides 或 PowerPoint 的时候发现的。为了检查自己的结果，agent 往往要把整页渲染成图片再看。这是有用的审阅，但没法度量、比较或优化：每次检查都是从像素重新猜一遍。所以我想要一种格式，让 agent 把一页当成数据来读。右边是本项目里 1BNA 那一页的真实片段：图表是一个对象，有边界、十二个数值和坐标轴范围。agent 可以只改一个值或一个标签，不碰别的，而且修改可以对比。我仍然会看渲染图来判断构图和可读性；它是审阅界面，不是可编辑的模型本身。"

designIntent.purpose: 动机三：截图只能看不能量；幻灯把页面作为结构化数据交给 agent，渲染图仍用于审阅。
